data.name: Ghaaliya
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'ghalila' which means 'to call'. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the one who calls to Allah, or the one who is called by Allah.

in_arabic.name: غالية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مؤنث معناه العالية القدر

in_urdu.name: غالیہ
in_urdu.meaning: عالی قدر اور بلند مقام کی مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: غالیہ ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے عالية القدر اور بلند مقام کی مالک، یہ نام برصغیر میں بھی بکثرت استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اسے اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت دی جاتی ہے

This name has a profound cultural impact, as it is often given to children as a reminder of their responsibility to spread the message of Islam and call others to the path of righteousness.
data.spiritual_significance: Ghaaliya is a deeply spiritual name, reflecting the close relationship between the human soul and Allah. The name implies a call and response between the believer and the Divine, resonating with the reminders found throughout the Quran to "call upon Me and I will answer your prayer." Additionally, Ghaaliya has a connotation of patience and steadfastness, as it takes considerable effort and resolve to consistently call upon Allah in a genuine and sincere manner. Ultimately, the name represents a profound connection to the divine, reminding us of the importance of turning to Allah in times of need and seeking His mercy and guidance in all aspects of life.
